explication: Conduit is a native Flutter mobile client for Open WebUI, compatible model endpoints, and self-hosted Hermes agents. Users connect an endpoint, authenticate when needed, then chat with streaming responses, attachments, and voice; they can also use workspace tools and other server-enabled features. Flutter feature modules implement the product, while Android and iOS bridges provide platform services such as background streaming, speech, widgets, and sharing. The README documents the main capabilities and integrations; several feature implementations were not sampled, so their internal call paths are not asserted.
